checkpoints.description: [1/2] Memoize quality/speed/prompt axis builders for repeated tune estimates

impact_assessment.benefits: Tune step estimates derive each frozen axis list once
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first build-count test, controlled HEAD-vs-WORK A/B hash, full npm test and 4/4 strict gates; revert if slower
impact_assessment.risks: contract: same frozen axis objects; dependency: steps identity + primitive keys; concurrency: none; state: WeakMap keyed by frozen steps
impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; after rungs/speedItems/sampling axes were cached, the three remaining axis builders still rebuilt per estimate call

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Reuse listProfiles stats in loadProfile to drop one stat per profiled model
